Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misidentified Lord Patrick Crichton-Stuart’s father as John Stuart, 1st Marquess of Bute (grandfather), conflating the title “Lord Mount Stuart” as an earlier style of the 1st Marquess rather than recognizing that Patrick’s actual father was John Stuart, Viscount (Lord) Mount Stuart (1767–1794). This misreading of the Wikipedia snippet led the process to search for and accept the grandfather’s death date (16 November 1814) instead of the father’s correct death date (22 January 1794).
